theme: 指数估值与财务指标·中证1000市盈率盘点与宽基指数对比
question: 往回看，2025年末的时候它的市盈率是多少？
answer:
生成查询代码
SELECT 
    v.TRD_DATE AS `交易日期`,
    g.INDX_CNAME AS `指数名称`,
    g.INDX_CODE AS `指数代码`,
    ROUND(v.PE,2) AS `市盈率(倍)`,
    ROUND(v.PB,2) AS `市净率(倍)`,
    ROUND(v.EPS,3) AS `每股收益(元)`,
    ROUND(v.SUM_TCAP/100000000,1) AS `总市值(亿)`,
    ROUND(v.SUM_MKTCAP/100000000,1) AS `流通市值(亿)`
FROM ANA_INDX_VAL_IDX v
INNER JOIN GET_INDX_GEN_INFO g
    ON v.INNER_CODE = g.INNER_CODE
WHERE g.INDX_CODE IN ('000852', '000922', '000010')
  AND g.USE_STATUS = '使用'
  AND g.ISVALID = 1
  AND v.ISVALID = 1
  AND v.PE IS NOT NULL
  AND v.TRD_DATE = (
      SELECT MAX(vv.TRD_DATE)
      FROM ANA_INDX_VAL_IDX vv
      INNER JOIN GET_INDX_GEN_INFO gg
          ON vv.INNER_CODE = gg.INNER_CODE
      WHERE gg.INDX_CODE = '000852' 
        AND gg.USE_STATUS = '使用'
        AND gg.ISVALID = 1
        AND vv.ISVALID = 1
        AND vv.TRD_DATE <= '2025-12-31'
  )
ORDER BY v.PE ASC;
